content.text: /ext:medcp Pick a commonly used anti-TNF therapy and report how many RA patients received it.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Drug' AND vocabulary_id IN ('RxNorm', 'NDC')
  AND (concept_name ILIKE '%adalimumab%'
       OR concept_name ILIKE '%infliximab%'
       OR concept_name ILIKE '%etanercept%'
       OR concept_name ILLIKE '%certolizumab%'
       OR concept_name ILIKE '%golimumab%')
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, concept_name
LIMIT 20;

content.text: SQL Server uses `LIKE` (case-insensitive by default) rather than `ILIKE`. Let me fix that and also look for the RA condition code first to tie patients to rheumatoid arthritis.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Drug' AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
  AND (UPPER(concept_name) LIKE '%ADALIMUMAB%'
       OR UPPER(concept_name) LIKE '%INFLIXIMAB%'
       OR UPPER(concept_name) LIKE '%ETANERCEPT%'
       OR UPPER(concept_name) LIKE '%CERTOLIZUMAB%'
       OR UPPER(concept_name) LIKE '%GOLIMUMAB%')
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE Upper(concept_name) LIKE '%RHEUMATOID ARTHRITIS%'
  AND domain_id = 'Condition'
ORDER BY standard_concept DESC, concept_id
LIMIT 10;

Good — RA is `concept_id = 80809` (standard concept) and adalimumab (`S` RxNorm) is `1119119`. Now I'll count unique person_ids who have both an RA diagnosis and an adalimumab prescription. SQL Server requires `TOP`, not `LIMIT`, so let me structure the query:

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS rx_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co2.person_id) FROM omop.condition_occurrence co2 WHERE co2.concept_id = 80809) AS ra_diagnoses_total
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON de.person_id = co.person_id
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 1119119 AND descent_type = 'all')
  AND co.concept_id = 80809;
